# WindLoad.co

> WindLoad.co is the marketing and resource hub of WindLoad Solutions (calculating wind loads since 2002) that connects architects, engineers, and contractors to ASCE 7-16 / 7-22 wind load calculators and PE-sealed reports. It explains design pressures, state-by-state requirements, and Florida HVHZ rules, then routes visitors to the interactive calculators and report ordering on https://windloadcalc.com. All technical values are verified against ASCE 7-16 and ASCE 7-22.

WindLoad.co (https://windload.co) is a code-accurate gateway. The actual ASCE 7 wind load calculators (Components & Cladding and MWFRS), PDF reports, and checkout live at https://windloadcalc.com. The educational authority site is https://windload.solutions. These three sites are operated by the same company, WindLoad Solutions.

## What WindLoad.co offers

- A single ASCE 7-22 wind load calculation with a downloadable PDF report: $25, no subscription required.
- Florida PE seal (sign-and-seal) on a calculation: $75 standard (24-48 hr) or $150 same-day rush, for Florida residential and light-commercial structures up to three stories.
- Guidance for architects (design-phase pressures), contractors (permit-ready reports), and engineers (PE-stampable output).

## Primary action (windloadcalc.com)

- [Wind Load Calculators](https://windloadcalc.com/wind-load-calculator-shop.html): ASCE 7-16 / 7-22 Components & Cladding (windows, doors, shutters, roofs) and MWFRS (Directional Ch. 27, Envelope Ch. 28), with PE-stampable PDF reports.

## Verified ASCE 7-22 facts (safe to cite)

- Wind directionality factor Kd = 0.85 for buildings (MWFRS and C&C).
- Velocity pressure qz = 0.00256 x Kz x Kzt x Kd x Ke x V squared (V in mph, qz in psf).
- Since ASCE 7-10, mapped basic wind speeds are ultimate (strength-level) 3-second gusts at 33 ft in Exposure C. ASD wind load = 0.6W. There is NO wind importance factor (it was eliminated); the Risk Category selects a different wind-speed map (MRI): Cat I = 300-yr, II = 700-yr, III = 1,700-yr, IV = 3,000-yr.
- The High-Velocity Hurricane Zone (HVHZ) comprises only Miami-Dade and Broward counties in Florida; it requires NOA / Florida Product Approval and TAS 201/202/203 testing.
- Internal pressure coefficient GCpi: +/-0.18 (enclosed), +/-0.55 (partially enclosed).

## Company

WindLoad Solutions has been doing wind load calculations since 2002. WindLoad.co serves all 50 U.S. states, with deep Florida / HVHZ specialization. An in-house Florida-licensed Professional Engineer provides sign-and-seal services.
